cases.name: Barbara Fernandes Raynor
cases.about:
She was a successful realtor for Weichert Realtors. “She was a very spirited, fun-loving, ‘I want to do the best I can’ kind of person,” said Dick Anderson, a friend of the couple for 15 years or more. Mrs. Raynor was an active real estate broker, beginning her sales career with Birchwood Realty in 1983. She was a top lister and seller for Birchwood Realty, moving into a position at the top of the company and continuing as a top producer for Century 21 Hughes & Carey Birchwood. She had been affiliated with Neves & Cashman Realty since 2002 and has also been a top producer for that firm, now merged with Weichert Realtors. Wally Kling, who worked for Barbara Raynor at Birchwood, described her as “a very good-hearted person, always concerned about other people. She didn’t go in for the stuff that some Realtors are known for.” “She came from the projects, so she had to overcome a lot of challenges,” Mr. Anderson said. “She grabbed hold of the real estate business and took off like a rocket...she had a hell of a following.” Mrs. Raynor was also an active member of the Cranberry Chamber of Commerce, a corporator of the Bridgewater Savings Bank, and a fund-raiser for the Old Colony YMCA Youth Support Group.
